;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**Ambassador to the [[United Nations]] for [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] [[Riyad Mansour]] says diplomats will ask the UN to probe the violence. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/the-latest-gaza-ministry-young-protesters-shot-in-the-head/2018/04/20/c3c6c03c-4481-11e8-b2dc-b0a403e4720a_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.c0eb5bed7ff3 (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons]] takes samples from the site of [[2018 Douma chemical weapons attack|a chemical weapons attack]] in [[Douma, Syria|Douma]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/syria-douma-chemical-weapons-attack-latest-eastern-ghouta-russia-assad-a8315746.html (''The Independent'')]
**Rebels in [[An-Nabek District|Qalamoun]] begin to evacuate after agreeing to surrender the region to Syria's government. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/04/syria-government-advances-rebels-evacuate-qalamoun-area-180421112701320.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Sweden]] hosts the [[United Nations]] [[UN Security Council|Security Council]] in [[Backåkra]] where the Syrian conflict is discussed by diplomats at a rare meeting outside the UN's New York headquarters. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43849270 (BBC News)]
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)]]
**An [[International Committee of the Red Cross]] aid worker is shot dead in [[Taizz Governorate]], [[Yemen]]. The [[United Nations]] condemns the attack. [https://reliefweb.int/report/yemen/united-nations-strongly-condemns-killing-icrc-colleague-yemen (Relief Web)]
**[[Yemen]]i [[Vice President of Yemen|Vice President]] Lt. Gen [[Ali Mohsen Saleh]] says a plot to overthrow the internationally recognised government by [[Iran]] and [[Houthi]] rebels has been foiled. [http://www.arabnews.com/node/1289206/middle-east (''Arab News'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**[[April 2018 Kabul suicide bombing (22 April 2018)|April 2018 Kabul suicide bombing]]
***A bomb explodes in a voter registration centre in [[Kabul]] killing at least 30 people and injuring approximately 50. [[Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant]] claim responsibility. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/22/asia/afghanistan-kabul-blast/index.html (CNN)]

;Arts and culture
* [[Nabi Tajima]], the [[oldest people|world's oldest person]], dies at age 117 in southern [[Japan]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/04/21/worlds-oldest-person-dies-southern-japan-117-years-old/539747002/ (''USA Today'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Germany|German]] manufacturer [[Bavaria Yachtbau]] is expected to collapse into administration. [http://www.yachtingmonthly.com/uncategorized/bavaria-yachts-expected-announce-administration-65537 (''Yachting Monthly'')]
*[[Ireland|Irish]] firm [[Smyths Toys]] agrees to buy 93 [[Toys R Us]] stores in [[Germany]], [[Austria]], and [[Switzerland]] plus four related online shops. [http://www.wowktv.com/news/smyths-toys-to-take-over-toys-r-us-stores-in-germany/1132357659 (WOWK TV)]

;International relations
*[[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**[[Japan]]ese [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]] praises [[North Korea]]'s statement that it would suspend nuclear and missile tests, but he also states the results must lead to verifiable denuclearization. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-japan/japan-pm-abe-says-north-korean-move-is-forward-motion-but-results-essential-idUSKBN1HS02P (Reuters)]
*[[Libya–Tunisia relations]]
**[[Tunisia]] reopens its embassy in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], [[Libya]]. The embassy has been closed since the kidnap of ten staff in 2015. [http://www.libyanexpress.com/tunisia-reopens-consulate-in-libyas-capital-tripoli/ (''The Libyan Express'')]
*[[Hamas]] says [[Palestinian people|Palestinian]] engineer Fadi al-Batsh, shot dead on his way to a mosque in [[Kuala Lumpur]], [[Malaysia]], today, was an important member. Hamas does not ascribe responsibility for the killing but the victim's relatives allege [[Israel]]i involvement. Israeli Education Minister [[Naftali Bennett]] calls al-Batsh a terrorist and says no burial will be permitted in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [http://www.wowktv.com/news/hamas-says-man-gunned-down-in-malaysia-was-important-member/1132287651 (WOWK TV)] [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/244757 (Israel National News)]
*The [[United Arab Emirates]] says [[Qatar]]i [[jet fighter]]s intercepted a passenger plane heading to [[Bahrain]] and flew dangerously close to it. [http://www.arabnews.com/node/1289326/breaking-news (''Arab News'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Terrorism in Australia]]
**Police in [[Sydney, Australia|Sydney]], [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]], charge a man with several crimes under the Terrorism High Risk Offenders Act. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2018/apr/21/sydney-man-charged-with-several-terror-related-offences (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2014–2018 Nicaraguan protests]]
**Ten people are killed in [[Nicaragua]] as anti-government protests over pension reforms enter their fourth day. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-43846643 (BBC News)]
*Police in [[Mahikeng]], Northwest Province, [[South Africa]], fire rubber bullets as protestors against corruption and public service provision riot. [[President of South Africa|President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] leaves a [[Commonwealth of Nations|Commonwealth]] summit in [[London]] to attend the scene. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/21/south-africa-riots-force-president-to-leave-commonwealth-summit (''The Guardian'')]
*[[India]]n lawmakers approve [[capital punishment]] for men who rape children under the age of 12. [[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] signs the measure. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-43850476 (BBC News)]
*[[Libya]]n terrorists bomb an oil pipeline near [[Mrada]], causing an explosion and fire. The same pipeline was previously attacked in December. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-04/22/c_137127535.htm (Xinhua)]
*Opposition demonstrations in [[Antananarivo]], [[Madagascar]], turn violent. Prime Minister [[Olivier Mahafaly Solonandrasana]] says one died and seventeen were injured but opposition Parliamentarian [[Hanitra Razafimanantsoa]], who supports ex-President [[Marc Ravalomanana]], says two were shot dead and two babies at a nearby hospital killed by [[tear gas]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-04/22/c_137127475.htm (Xinhua)]

**[[Mitt Romney]] says that he won't commit to supporting [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] in the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 presidential election]]. [http://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/384299-romney-wont-commit-to-supporting-trump-in-2020 (''The Hill'')]
*[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Donald Trump]] is considering a posthumous pardon for [[Jack Johnson]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/early-lead/wp/2018/04/21/who-is-jack-johnson-the-boxer-trump-is-considering-for-posthumous-pardon/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Wales|Welsh]] [[First Minister of Wales|First Minister]] [[Carwyn Jones]] announces his plans to step down this autumn. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-43851468 (BBC News)]

;Sports
*[[2017–18 NBA season]]
**[[2017–18 Milwaukee Bucks season]]
***The [[Milwaukee Bucks]] announces [[Green Bay Packers]] [[quarterback]] [[Aaron Rodgers]] will be a part owner of the franchise. [http://bleacherreport.com/articles/2771706-aaron-rodgers-announced-as-part-owner-of-bucks-franchise-at-game-vs-celtics (Bleacher Report)]
**[[2018 NBA Playoffs]]
***The [[New Orleans Pelicans]] became the first No. 6 seed (or lower) to sweep its first-round series since the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] switched from its best-of-five format in 2003 after their 131–123 game 4 win over the [[Portland Trail Blazers]]. [[Anthony Davis (basketball)|Anthony Davis]] scored 47 points and [[Jrue Holiday]] 41 points during the win. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/2018/04/21/no-6-seed-pelicans-nba-playoff-history-first-round-sweep-trail-blazers/539641002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://uproxx.com/dimemag/pelicans-sweep-blazers-anthony-davis-highlights-game-4-playoffs/ (UPRX)]
